message.content: {"version":"1","text":"You are ready for your New Year celebration at the upscale restaurant. This chocolate blazer and matching trousers set you apart with a sophisticated, monochromatic elegance that fits a formal evening perfectly. The emerald green boots add a deep, festive pop of color to your feet, while the gold flower bracelet catches the light without being too loud. You hold the lilac geometric bag in your hand, its bright pattern offering a perfect visual break against the dark brown tones of your suit.","how_to_wear":["Unbutton the top of the blazer when you settle onto your chair or make a toast to let your neckline breathe and relax your shoulders.","Take the green boots off if you want to feel warmer at the table, but keep them on if the restaurant floor is cold and you need that cozy protection."],"wrong_photos":[],"swap":{"item":null,"why":null,"to":null},"named":["#59·11","#26·19","#406·31","#420·09","#37·38"],"about_items":[{"n":"#59·11","text":"This chocolate-colored blazer is cut from a thick, matte fabric that feels structured and expensive. It has wide lapels that frame your face beautifully and long sleeves that drape loosely over your arms for a relaxed yet polished look."},{"n":"#26·19","text":"These trousers in cappuccino brown sit comfortably on your waist with a high rise and a clean, straight silhouette that lengthens your legs. The fabric is smooth and holds its shape well without feeling stiff."},{"n":"#406·31","text":"The bracelet is a rigid piece made of gold-toned metal featuring an intricate relief flower design that looks like a real bloom. Its sculptural shape adds texture to your wrist without any distracting movement."},{"n":"#420·09","text":"These boots are crafted from soft emerald green suede and feature a comfortable wedge heel with a slight stretch at the ankle for easy slip-on wear."},{"n":"#37·38","text":"This crossbody bag is made of sturdy lilac canvas and decorated with rows of colorful geometric triangles in pink, blue, yellow, and green. It has a practical zip closure and an adjustable strap that lets you carry it comfortably across your body."}]}
